0.name: Hero
0.title: Hero
0.description: A hero is a unit that allows you to play cards of its color in its lane. A hero can equip items. When it is killed, it is worth 5 Bounty to the opponent and returns to the Fountain to be redeployed later.

1.name: Creep
1.title: Creep
1.description: A creep is a non-hero unit. Unlike a hero, a creep cannot equip items, and does not return to play after it is killed. It is worth 1 Bounty to the opponent when killed.

2.name: Tower
2.title: Tower
2.description: Each lane contains an allied tower that must be defended and an enemy tower that must be destroyed. The objective of the game is to destroy any 2 enemy towers. The tower can be a target of some spells and abilities.

3.name: Improvement
3.title: Improvement
3.description: An improvement (▩) is a card that has a permanent effect on a tower. Improvements are cross lane cards (when played, they use mana and heroes from the active lane, but can be played into any lane.) Improvements are not units and do not occupy combat positions.

4.name: Spell
4.title: Spell
4.description: A spell (▪) is a card that has a one-time effect and is then removed from the game. Spells deal damage, modify objects in play temporarily or permanently, summon units, or draw cards.

5.name: Item
5.title: Item
5.description: An item is a card that can be purchased during the shopping phase using gold. A Weapon, Armor, or Accessory item is equipped onto a hero to buff its stats. A consumable item has a one-time effect and is then removed from the game.

300.name: Fountain
300.title: Fountain
300.description: When heroes die they are placed in the Fountain zone for a full round before becoming ready to redeploy. When heroes enter the Fountain they are fully healed and temporary effects on them are purged.

400.name: Battle
400.title: Battle
400.description: When a unit battles, it deals its Attack damage to its target. When units battle each other, they deal their damage simultaneously. Combat attributes such as Armor, Retaliate, and Piercing are applied.

401.name: Modify
401.title: Modify
401.description: When an effect modifies another card it applies a permanent buff or debuff to the target. Heroes retain modifiers through death.

402.name: Purge
402.title: Purge
402.description: Removes modifications and temporary effects, but not damage. Purging does not affect base abilities or external effects, such as those from equipped items and continuous effects from neighbors or improvements.

403.name: Taunts
403.title: Taunt
403.description: When a unit taunts all of its enemy neighbors change their combat target to that unit.

404.name: Disarm
404.title: Disarm
404.description: A disarmed unit does not attack its target during battles.

405.name: Stun
405.title: Stun
405.description: A stunned unit is silenced (cannot use any active abilities and cannot be used to play cards of its color) and disarmed (does not attack its target during battles).

406.name: Silence
406.title: Silence
406.description: A silenced unit cannot use its active abilities or item active abilities. A silenced hero cannot be used to play cards of its color.

407.name: Lock
407.title: Lock
407.description: A delay that prevents the card from being played for that many rounds. Lock decreases at the end of the round.

408.name: Condemn
408.title: Condemn
408.description: Mark a unit, improvement, or equipment for death. Death Shields may save a condemned unit, but Damage Immunity does not.

409.name: Summon
409.title: Summon
409.description: Create a unit and immediately put it into a random empty combat position.

500.name: Bounty
500.title: Bounty
500.description: The amount of gold awarded to the opponent when this unit dies.

501.name: Siege
501.title: Siege
501.description: When blocked during the combat phase, in addition to battle damage to the blocking unit, also deal the Siege damage to the enemy tower.

502.name: Cleave
502.title: Cleave
502.description: When blocked during the combat phase, in addition to battle damage to the blocking unit, also deal the Cleave damage to that unit's neighbors.

503.name: Retaliate
503.title: Retaliate
503.description: When attacked during a battle (even outside of the combat phase), deal this much extra damage to the attackers.

504.name: Armor
504.title: Armor
504.description: Armor reduces each incoming damage source by that amount.

505.name: Regeneration
505.title: Regeneration
505.description: The unit heals this amount during the combat phase. Regeneration is applied before checking for death.

506.name: Death Shield
506.title: Death Shield
506.description: If a unit would die, instead remove its death shield and it survives with 1 Health. A unit may only have one death shield at a time.

507.name: Damage Immunity
507.title: Damage Immunity
507.description: A unit with Damage Immunity does not take damage. It will still die if condemned.

508.name: Piercing
508.title: Piercing
508.description: Piercing damage is not reduced by the target's armor.

509.name: Attack
509.title: Attack
509.description: The amount of damage a unit deals during battle.

510.name: Health
510.title: Health
510.description: The amount of damage a unit can sustain before dying. Damage persists across rounds.

511.name: Mana
511.title: Mana
511.description: Current mana. Resource required to cast spells.

512.name: Soulbound
512.title: Soulbound
512.description: When an allied unit with soulbound dies, all other allied units in any lane with the same name also die.

600.name: Enemy neighbors
600.title: Enemy Neighbors
600.description: Any enemies in the three enemy combat positions closest to this unit.

601.name: Allied neighbors
601.title: Allied Neighbors
601.description: The units directly to the left and right of a unit.

602.name: Play Effect
602.title: Play Effect
602.description: An additional effect that is processed at the time you play this creep.

603.name: Death Effect
603.title: Death Effect
603.description: An effect that is processed after this unit dies.

604.name: Get initiative
604.title: ▢ Get Initiative
604.description: After you play this spell, you get the initiative coin and may immediately take another action. If you use this action to pass, you will retain initiative and may act first in the next lane.

606.name: Unblocked
606.title: Unblocked
606.description: A unit is unblocked if its combat target is the tower.

607.name: Unit
607.title: Unit
607.description: A unit is any creep or hero in a combat position. Towers are not units.

609.name: Battle damage
609.title: Battle Damage
609.description: Any damage assigned during a battle, most often during the combat phase.

610.name: Rapid Deployment
610.title: Rapid Deployment
610.description: When a hero with Rapid Deployment dies, it is immediately ready for deployment, so it can be deployed at the start of the next round.

611.name: Pierce
611.title: Pierce
611.description: Damage from a unit with Pierce is not reduced by the target's armor.

WeaponItem.title: Weapon Item
WeaponItem.description: A type of item that is equipped in a hero's weapon slot. All weapons increase a hero's Attack.

ArmorItem.title: Armor Item
ArmorItem.description: A type of item that is equipped in a hero's armor slot. All armors increase a hero's Armor.

AccessoryItem.title: Accessory Item
AccessoryItem.description: A type of item that is equipped in a hero's accessory slot. All accessories increase a hero's Health.

ConsumableItem.title: Consumable
ConsumableItem.description: A type of item that is not equipped and is played during the action phase like a spell. Consumables do not cost mana to play and may be played without a hero in the lane.

CombatPhase.title: Lane Phases
CombatPhase.description:
There are four phases in each lane.

Before the action phase: Many reactive abilities trigger automatically. All triggers happen simultaneously.
Action phase: Players alternate playing cards or abilities.
Combat phase: Each unit battles its combat target simultaneously.
After the combat phase: Many reactive abilities trigger automatically. All triggers happen simultaneously.

ActionPhase.description:

Action phase: Players alternate playing cards or abilities.
Combat phase: Each unit battles its combat target simultaneously.
After the combat phase: Many reactive abilities trigger automatically. All triggers happen simultaneously.

DeploymentPhase.title: Round Phases
DeploymentPhase.description:
There are two phases in between rounds. These phases are played by both players simultaneously.

Shopping phase: Players purchase cards from the item shops using gold.
Deployment phase: Lane creeps are revealed and players choose which lanes to deploy their ready heroes into.

Active.title: Active Ability
Active.description: An active ability may be used during the action phase. An active ability with a cooldown may not be used again until that number of rounds have passed. Active abilities may not be used if their owner is stunned or silenced.
